## Historical audit: H0105

**Scope.** This is chunk 2 of 2 only. The original trajectory is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane4/codex_parallel_08_lane4_H_r1/infer_logs/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event citations below refer to that file; offsets are the supplied observation boundaries. The task name and visible implementation suggest an automatic table-of-contents rule, but the original requirements are not visible here.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Event 68, chars [0,5017); event 70, chars [0,6315) | The visible utility generates a TOC around markers, protects code, math and frontmatter ranges, and handles heading options, exclusions and anchors. These are observed code operations, not proof that they meet the specification. |
| Events 69–70, chars [0,1090) and [0,6315) | A successful edit changed an escape-character regex and a documentation comment. The effect of the regex change is not independently tested in the visible subsequent events. |
| Events 71–74, chars [0,741), [0,588), [0,850), [0,783) | Status showed one modified locale file and two untracked Auto TOC files. The student staged and committed them: three files, 159 insertions, commit `ff5ff30`. Thus this was not an empty patch. |
| Event 66, chars [0,89166) | The examples suite reported 410/410 passing, including the Auto TOC marker example and its augmented example, with exit code 0. It also reported a force-exited worker and possible teardown leaks. This result precedes the final regex edit. |
| Event 75, chars [0,1045) | The student reported that the production build did not complete because dependencies were missing and that the full type-check reported dependency and existing-project errors; it claimed a separate new-file check had no errors. These are student reports, not independently visible command results in this chunk. |
| H0105 supplied inventory metadata | Formal status is `not_solved`: 0/41 fail-to-pass and 1131/1131 pass-to-pass. This differs from the successful local examples suite and supports a formally unsuccessful submission, not a diagnosis of the failing algorithm. |

**Teacher and exploration.** The inventory lists available hint materials, but this chunk shows neither their delivered text nor evidence of student adoption. After-round review is not input to this round. The student visibly inspected code, edited it, checked process/repository status, and committed; earlier autonomous exploration cannot be reconstructed from this chunk.

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a passing existing example suite does not establish success on the target evaluation; validation after a final edit also matters. Task-specifically, the visible marker example passed, while the formal target tests did not. Their failure details, the exact requirements, the cause of failure, and the final edit’s behavioral effect remain unresolved. The worker warning and reported build failure do not by themselves explain the formal result.
